description: Extract the text of a PowerPoint .pptx deck as Markdown: one "## Slide N: title" section per slide in presentation order, text boxes as paragraphs and bullet lists (with indent levels), tables as Markdown tables, and speaker notes as a quote under each slide. Images, charts and SmartArt text are not extracted. Old binary .ppt is not supported. Optional "slides" range (e.g. "1-5, 8"). Accepts a local path or base64. Inline Markdown is cut at maxChars (default 200k); "output" saves it to a file. Runs locally; nothing is uploaded.

file.description: The .pptx presentation: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

maxChars.description: Cut the inline Markdown after this many characters, with a note (a file written with "output" is never cut). Default 200000.

output.description: Write the Markdown to this file (or folder ending in "/") and return its path instead of the inline text.

slides.description: Slides to include, e.g. "1-3, 7" or "5-" (1-based). Default: all.

name: ai_pptx_to_markdown
title: PowerPoint (.pptx) to Markdown
